title: Add a sense to an entry
description: Adds one new sense, with a gloss, to an entry that exists, pointing it at one of the entry's own analyses so the analysis and alternate forms stay shared; Motif stages a Draft for a person to review and Apply. An entry with one analysis needs no analysis field; an entry with several refuses and lists their ids. It refuses an unknown entry, an analysis the entry lacks, a writing system the project does not have, and a gloss the entry already has.
